edits.prompt: Edit this dictionary illustration. Keep the smartphone body, pure white background, semi-realistic rendering, framing and highlighted central blue calendar application icon. Replace every OTHER application icon with simple generic unbranded pictograms or abstract geometric shapes, using a total of nine icons in a 3 by 3 grid, with the highlighted blue calendar at the CENTER. No Apple Photos rainbow flower, Apple Maps roads, branded logos, recognizable commercial app marks, letters, words or numbers. All icons should feel generic and distinct. The highlighted calendar must be the unmistakable subject representing one app. Keep the entire phone visible with generous padding. Do not add objects.

Precise small edit: Keep the main smartphone, main leaf image, white background, composition and lighting completely unchanged. Fix ONLY the screenshot-preview thumbnail at the bottom left INSIDE the screen. It must be a small rounded rectangular miniature of the DISPLAY CONTENT ONLY: green leaf on light gray background. Remove the tiny black phone frame, notch, camera, and device outline currently inside this thumbnail. A thin white screenshot-preview border and subtle shadow may remain. The thumbnail must NOT depict another phone, only a captured image of the leaf screen content. No new objects, no words, no icons.
